BE NICE:
The individuals presented in these videos may be suffering from the effects of alcohol, drug abuse, a mental health disorder or simply having a bad day. The videos should NOT be presumed to be representative of their general behavior. Everyone deserves to be treated with respect. 

RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN:
Midwest Safety practices the "Right to be Forgotten." If you were the suspect in a lower-level offense, you may email our board to request removal: https://midwest.clickup.com/forms/9006119175/f/8ccwy87-63557/LE0PT31DZVHHEIE5AW

The suspect's 79-year-old mother was checked by EMS at the scene and was not injured but was shaken and later calmed down. The suspect identified as Jose Rivera was already wanted on an outstanding. warrant related to a previous DUI offense. He was ultimately charged with multiple offenses, including evading arrest with a vehicle, evading arrest with a previous conviction, failure to identify with intent to provide false information, tampering with physical evidence with intent to impair, possession of a controlled substance, resisting arrest search or transport, parole warrant and attempted capital murder of a peace officer or firefighter, totaling a bond of $165,000. However, the capital murder charge was later dismissed by court order and did not proceed further. Jose Rivera is innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

He was later arrested and charged with multiple offenses, including attempted capital murder (later dismissed). His elderly mother was present but not injured.
